name: indahl-correct
description: Record a correction beside the original, never over it: what was wrong, who caught it, when, the evidence, the corrected text, and whether every place that cited the original was reached. Produces a corrections ledger entry and a list of downstream places to update. Use when an error is found in anything already published or sent - a paper, a page, a report, a dataset, a message. Nothing is sent outside your session.
